title: Watersound "Serenity Breeze" 224 E. Yacht Pond Lane
h1: Watersound "Serenity Breeze" 224 E. Yacht Pond Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private Deeded Beach Access- Located in a secure, gated community with on-site security- Located 200 yard from the beach- Golf cart- Private Pool **Pool heating available Oct 1 through May 1 for $35 per day**- Elevator (Only accessible on the first and second floor)- 5 adult bikes- From March 1st to October 31st, the rental of this property includes one beach service set (2 beach chairs and 1umbrella)- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout- This property come with 3 designated parking spaces. This home permits a maximum of 3 vehicles through the community security gate.DETAILS: Feel the "Serenity Breeze" and smell the salt air from the 224 Yacht Pond Lane rooftop! This 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom home can sleep up to 15 and is located in WaterSound, just 200 yards from private beach access. The home has a private pool with lounge seating and heating capabilities to enjoy year-round. There are top-notch amenities for guests to enjoy, such as a SONOS system throughout, Smart TVs in every room, and Gulf views from the lookout tower. Upon entering the home, you are immediately welcomed by an open kitchen and living room with hardwood floors, sparkling quartz countertops, and beautiful white cabinetry. The kitchen has premium stainless steel appliances, including a wine fridge and seating for 8 at the dining table. Through the spacious living area, there is a screened-in grilling area that serves as an outdoor living room and a flat-screen TV and fireplace. There is a laundry room and guest bedroom with a California king bed also on the first floor.The second floor boasts 2 more guest rooms with king beds and private bathrooms and an additional living room with a queen sleeper sofa. The primary bedroom on this floor also has its own balcony overlooking the pond. Finally, take the stairs to the third-floor nook with a built-in bunk and bathroom and access the lookout tower. The lookout features 360-degree views of the WaterSound community and miles of coastline. There is also an attached carriage house with a full bedroom and bunk room. The bedroom has a California king bed, private bathroom, and separate bunk room with 2 twin-over-twin built-in bunks. This is the perfect vacation home for multi-generational families who want to stay in the heart of 30A! Take the bikes for a stroll around the many trails and paths throughout WaterSound, or for a short trip to Chill (fka The Hub), where you'll find family-friendly restaurants and shopping. Don't miss your chance to stay at "Serenity Breeze"!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSFIRST FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: California King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyHalf BathroomSECOND FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub Separate Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyLiving Area: Queen Sleeper SofaTHIRD FLOOR:Twin Bed CubbyHalf BathroomATTACHED CARRIAGE HOUSE:Guest Bedroom: California King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyBunk Bedroom: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub comboIMPORTANT INFORMATION *Walton County regulations require all doors leading to private pools to have an alarm that sounds when the door is slightly open (ajar). This alarm needs to be manually turned off when exiting the pool area. Due to this safety requirement, the accordion doors cannot be used by guests.*This is a peaceful community. To ensure everyone's enjoyment, weddings, parties, gatherings exceeding a reasonable number of guests, and guests of guests are strictly prohibited. Violation of this policy may result in immediate removal from the property, forfeiture of any remaining rental fees, and potential fines from the HOA, community, and 360 Blue.*No smoking or pets are allowed on the property.*Fireplaces are not for guest use.
